contract: ../DESIGN.md Header controls update: dashboard actions in main header, no separate row or success text, persistent error feedback, responsive/RTL/focus and existing widget behavior.

accessibility.evidence: Native labeled selectors/buttons retained in a Layout group. Empty-layout recovery focuses the picker in the header. Visible focus styles retained, Arabic RTL layout inspected. Full screen-reader testing remains unperformed.

responsive.evidence: Header controls fit at 390x844 Arabic/light, 844x390 French/dark, 768x1024 Spanish/light, 1440x900 and 1920x1080 English/dark, normal/edit modes with extra-large numbers. No controls escape the header or cause horizontal document overflow; scrollbar tracks remain hidden.

loading.evidence: Browser and packaged macOS app mount controls in header, retain 88 channel rows and all original widgets without null-reference errors.

empty.evidence: Normal save status is empty and hidden. Explicit empty layout opens the header picker and Add recovers an instrument. No game data generated.

error.evidence: Forced isolated Storage.setItem failure shows the translated temporary-layout message. Restoring storage and saving clears/hides the message, without a success banner.

partial.evidence: No game stream retains waiting/em-dash state; moving layout controls preserves original instrument nodes and available-data behavior.

success.evidence: 29 tests pass. Browser Add/Move/Hide, persisted 8-column/480px sizes, reset, same-canvas identity and detail navigation checked. Focus hides layout controls normally and preserves them while editing. Packaged macOS app reports headerControls/noViewToolbar/quietSave true; 41 files match in all three packaged app archives.

permission.reason: Local DOM/CSS relocation adds no runtime permission, network endpoint or data exposure. Release publication remains outside this change.

French landscape controls fit inside the main header; canvas keeps internal scrolling.
Spanish light editing uses a wrapped header with every action available.
Single desktop header contains layout, editing and widget actions.
Wide header retains logo/source/focus and all editing actions without separate row.
